description: This file implements a Windows-specific ANSI terminal event handler for the 'go-ansiterm' library, managing console output, cursor movements, screen buffer operations, and escape sequence handling on Windows systems.

classes.name: windowsAnsiEventHandler
classes.description: A struct managing Windows console ANSI escape sequences, cursor positioning, screen buffer, and text attributes.

methods.name: simulateLF
methods.description: Simulates a line feed or carriage return + line feed, handling scrolling within scroll regions.

methods.name: executeLF
methods.description: Executes a line feed without a carriage return, handling console buffer updates.

methods.name: Print
methods.description: Handles printing a byte to the console, managing line wrapping.

methods.name: Execute
methods.description: Executes ANSI control characters such as tab, bell, backspace, line feed, and carriage return.

methods.name: CUU
methods.description: Moves cursor up by a specified number of lines.

methods.name: CUD
methods.description: Moves cursor down by a specified number of lines.

methods.name: CUF
methods.description: Moves cursor forward (right) by a specified number of columns.

methods.name: CUB
methods.description: Moves cursor backward (left) by a specified number of columns.

methods.name: CNL
methods.description: Moves cursor to the beginning of a specified line below the current line.

methods.name: CPL
methods.description: Moves cursor to the beginning of a specified line above the current line.

methods.name: CHA
methods.description: Moves cursor to a specified horizontal position.

methods.name: VPA
methods.description: Moves cursor vertically to a specified position.

methods.name: CUP
methods.description: Moves cursor to a specified row and column.

methods.name: HVP
methods.description: Moves cursor to a specified position (alias for CUP).

methods.name: DECTCEM
methods.description: Sets cursor visibility (not implemented).

methods.name: DECOM
methods.description: Enables or disables origin mode.

methods.name: DECCOLM
methods.description: Sets terminal width to 80 or 132 columns.

methods.name: ED
methods.description: Erases parts of the screen buffer based on parameter.

methods.name: EL
methods.description: Erases parts of the current line based on parameter.

methods.name: IL
methods.description: Inserts lines at the cursor position.

methods.name: DL
methods.description: Deletes lines at the cursor position.

methods.name: ICH
methods.description: Inserts blank characters at the cursor position.

methods.name: DCH
methods.description: Deletes characters at the cursor position.

methods.name: SGR
methods.description: Sets text attributes like color and style.

methods.name: SU
methods.description: Scrolls the display up.

methods.name: SD
methods.description: Scrolls the display down.

methods.name: DA
methods.description: Device Attributes (not implemented).

methods.name: DECSTBM
methods.description: Sets scroll region top and bottom margins.

methods.name: RI
methods.description: Reverse index (scroll down).

methods.name: IND
methods.description: Index (scroll up).

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Flushes buffered output to the console and draws margin byte if needed.

methods.name: getCurrentInfo
methods.description: Retrieves current console buffer info, caching it.

methods.name: updatePos
methods.description: Updates current cursor position.

methods.name: clearWrap
methods.description: Clears line wrap state.
